name: sandboxes
description: Managed E2B / Daytona sandbox adapters plus a sandboxes CLI and a sandboxes-mcp MCP server. The 1.0.0 rebuild removed the sandboxes-serve HTTP server and the broad Postgres-backed sandbox store, so this repo declares no HTTP service surface and owns no configured database of its own.

mcp.supervisor: systemd unit running the sandboxes-mcp bin

storage.postgres: The optional durable task journal and its independent witness run against a PostgresClientV1 the caller supplies; sandboxes resolves no connection string of its own.
storage.sqlite: Not implemented. No SQLite store ships in this repo, so storage.engines deliberately claims none.
